description: Unit tests for tenantClient utility functions: normalization, fetching session tenants, selecting a tenant, and setting active tenant in local storage.

methods.name: normalizeTenantId
methods.description: Normalizes various tenant ID object shapes or a string to a string ID or null.

methods.name: fetchSessionTenants
methods.description: Fetches tenant items from the session API endpoint.

methods.name: selectTenant
methods.description: Selects a tenant by ID, updates local storage, and makes a POST request to the server.

methods.name: setActiveTenant
methods.description: Stores the preferred tenant ID in local storage, replacing legacy data.

methods.name: getActiveTenant
methods.description: Retrieves the currently active tenant ID from local storage.
